specs.name: hot-instrument-a
specs.rationale: Dominant joint tuple (Ioc, 100, 0.01) at ~52% of samples; pinning all three fields folds both divisions and the fee switch.

specs.name: hot-instrument-b
specs.rationale: Second mode (Ioc, 10, 0.25) at ~43%; together with spec 0 covers ~95% of orders.

specs.name: ioc-partial
specs.rationale: Partial specialization: ~99% of ALL orders are Ioc, so for noise orders missing specs 0-1 we can still fold the fee switch while keeping lot/tick as runtime reads.

notes: Specs 0-1 cover the two hot instruments; spec 2 catches residual Ioc noise at low value — the benchmark gate should decide whether its extra dispatch branch pays. Next beyond value specialization: hoist the tick multiply into a per-instrument table, and consider splitting Order into hot/cold halves.
